title: A different museum experience
text:
A very beautiful and enriching experience for those of us who love art and let ourselves be overwhelmed by creativity.

A pleasant and different activity to do on a trip alone, as a couple, or with family.

I highly recommend it.
author: Carmenpalmero

title: MoCo Museum in Barcelona!
text: This is a must see in Barcelona! The museum is well curated and has an excellent audio guy-bring your earbuds. Raphael at the front desk is quite helpful and pleasant.
author: Fearless300625

title: Very attractive
text: A breath of fresh air for new art!   After several days in Europe, seeing this museum gives hope that our generation will leave something for the future.
author: Freedom725329

title: An experience you cannot miss
text: A museum experience, totally different, modernist. The guide is excellent and I recommend that you bring headphones so that you can enjoy it at your leisure. The visit, if you use the self-guided tour, takes approximately two hours. Along with the National Art Museum of Catalonia and the Museum of Contemporary Art of Barcelona, it is one of the best museums I have seen.
author: Picu

title: Fantastic Small Museum!
text: Attended on 29/9/26. The exhibit was considered and concise, but really interesting. The audio guide was especially helpful. I LOVED the Banksy exhibit as well as the Robbie Williams pieces. Museum was not crowded at all and one could see all the pieces.
author: Chet_S

title: Fantastic
text:
I loved visiting the Moco Museum in Barcelona! 🎨✨ It's a super interesting, modern space full of incredible works. The exhibition is very engaging and different from the concept of a traditional museum, with several pieces that make us stop, observe, and reflect.

It was an experience I really liked and that I recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona! Without a doubt, one of the museums I liked the most to visit. ❤️
author: AbaptistaODV

title: Absolutely Outstanding – A Barcelona Must-See
text:
What a fantastic experience. From the moment we arrived, the Moco Museum Barcelona impressed us on every level.

We were lucky enough to have a great offer with two tickets for the price of one, including a glass of cava, which was already a wonderful start. But even without the offer, the museum itself would have been worth every cent.
